notes.title: Steam Autumn Sale is now open!
notes.content: As of November 27th, I am pleased to announce that Broad Daylight is now officially on sale for 50% off the original price! This sale will only last about four days, so get it quick before it's gone!

notes.title: Broad Daylight ver 1.1 is now LIVE!
Project Daylight First Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Lowering texture resolution to a max of 1024x1024 to lower demands of high graphics
[*] Added new achievements to attain
[*] Clarified objectives and interactable objects in the world
[/list]

Side note: I somehow managed to turn a build of 3.2 GB or size to 1.16 GB with one move! Hooray, compression!
